edges.sentence: On 2026-10-01, The Hill reported “The Treasury Department sanctioned Iranian auto and rail industries Thursday, the latest salvo in its economic campaign against the Islamic Republic.”; on 2026-10-02, Al Jazeera reported “Washington has paired the show of force with new economic pressure, sanctioning Iran’s rail and automotive conglomerates this week, as the Treasury Department called the new measures an effort to drain what remains of Tehran’s revenue.”.

On 2026-10-01, The Hill reported “The Treasury Department’s Office of Foreign Assets Control (OFAC) sanctioned the entirety of those industries — going after automobile, train and manufacturing companies — which the administration views as critical sources of funding for the regime, the department noted in a release.”; on 2026-10-02, Al Jazeera reported “Washington has paired the show of force with new economic pressure, sanctioning Iran’s rail and automotive conglomerates this week, as the Treasury Department called the new measures an effort to drain what remains of Tehran’s revenue.”.

On 2026-10-01, The Hill reported “The Treasury Department’s Office of Foreign Assets Control (OFAC) sanctioned the entirety of those industries — going after automobile, train and manufacturing companies — which the administration views as critical sources of funding for the regime, the department noted in a release.”; on the same day, The Hill reported “The Treasury Department sanctioned Iranian auto and rail industries Thursday, the latest salvo in its economic campaign against the Islamic Republic.”.

On 2026-10-01, Reuters reported “Treasury said the two companies represent more than 90% of Iran’s domestic auto market.”; on the same day, The Hill reported “Iran’s domestic auto industry is dominated by two firms, Iran Khodro Co. and SAIPA Iranian Automobile Manufacturing Co., which control more than 90 percent of the market.”.
